en.subtitle: Plan trips, search every leg
en.short_description: Keep every leg of a trip together and search flights, stays and cars in one go.
en.description:
TripNest keeps a trip together. Create "Mumbai to Goa, Mar 10-14" once, search every leg of it from one place, and keep the flight, the bus, the stay and the airport transfer you book on that same itinerary.

—— What you can do ——

TRIPS
Create a trip with its destination, dates and travellers. Add each booking you make — flight, hotel, car, bus or airport transfer — with who it is with, the date and the confirmation code, and mark it booked when it is. Trips move to Past once their dates have gone by.

ONE SEARCH FORM, SIX WAYS TO TRAVEL
Flights · Hotels · Cars · Buses · Stays + Flight · Airport transfer. Fill in the form once and TripNest opens the search on Google Flights, Booking.com or Airbnb with your places, dates and travellers already filled in, or on Google Maps with your places filled in. TripNest does not show live prices and does not sell travel: you compare and book on those sites.

ITINERARY IDEAS
A day-by-day plan of highlights and tips for Goa, Paris, Tokyo, Bali and New York, which you can save as a trip.

TRIP IDEAS FROM YOUR HOME CITY
Set your home city and Home starts its destination ideas, searches and new trips from it.

—— No account, ever ——

TripNest has no sign-in. Your trips and preferences live on your device, and Settings can delete them all.

—— How TripNest makes money ——

TripNest shows ads from Google AdMob. The travel sites it opens are not affiliates: TripNest earns nothing from those links, and the site's own price, terms, cancellation policy and support apply to anything you book there.

en.release_notes:
First release of TripNest.

• Create trips and keep every booking you make - flights, hotels, cars, buses and airport transfers - on one itinerary
• One search form that opens Google Flights, Booking.com or Airbnb with your places, dates and travellers filled in, or Google Maps with your places
• Itinerary ideas for Goa, Paris, Tokyo, Bali and New York
• Trip ideas and searches that start from your home city
• No account and no sign-in - everything lives on your device

TripNest does not show live prices or sell travel, and earns nothing from the sites it opens. It is supported by ads.

Feedback: contact@americangroup.ai

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
TripNest keeps a trip together. Create "Mumbai to Goa, Mar 10-14" once, search every leg of it from one place, and keep the flight, the bus, the stay and the airport transfer you book on that same itinerary.

Intended audience:
Plan trips, search every leg

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- Google AdMob — advertising

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app follows the device language for 12 locales (Arabic, Chinese (Simplified), English, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Spanish), but translation is partial: shared labels are translated, while most screen text is in English only. Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
